t: This is Gilbey House, the former Gilbey's Gin distillery, factory and offices, here in Camden Town. It was designed by two architects. Erich Mendelsohn, a Jewish-German architect, is known for his expressionist buildings of the 1920s and for a dynamic functionalism in his department stores and cinemas. Serge Chermayeff, born in Russia, became a British and later American architect, industrial designer and writer. Together their names give this building a place in the story of modern architecture in London.
